evidence: Ideal-gas, stoichiometric and perfectly mixed purge reference calculations. No ignition, flame propagation, explosion pressure, emission rate, qualified material or lunar safety factor is calculated.
reading_rule: SI units. Rounded binary dry O2/N2 mixtures at equal 301 K; pressure and composition come from the bound pressure-advantages product. Gravity is absent from these conservation identities and must be assessed separately. Purge endpoints are arbitrary mathematical comparisons, never qualified inerting limits.

research/studies/world_economy/results/p.use: environment.reference_Pa, locked_Pa, temperature_K; gas_partial_pressures.reference_oxygen_Pa and locked_oxygen_Pa

methane.basis: One mole CH4, complete conversion to CO2 and gaseous H2O; N2 unchanged. No dissociation, kinetics, soot, NOx, radiation or gas temperature prediction. Methane is an accounting example, not an adopted lunar fuel.

purge.basis: Pure N2 inflow with simultaneous well-mixed outflow; constant vessel volume, absolute pressure and temperature. No leaks, desorption, mixing dead zones or gas-separation/compression costs. Equal final mole fraction and equal final partial pressure are different services.
